semanticOwner: The public Distribution Launcher is a thin composition host only. terminalContract: The host resolves one deterministic default managed-root child for downloaded delivery media, loads the two exact embedded resource logical names, constructs one shared state store, root probe, payload source, VersionManagementExperience, root materializer and Bootstrap handoff, then runs ManagedLauncherEntryCoordinator before any Setup source access. Healthy installed entry performs no Registry/Catalog/package access. SetupRequired is the only outcome that may expose the existing first-install experience. All other outcomes remain typed terminal process results and never fall through to Setup. The IImmutableBootstrapHandoff path accepts the exact root already supplied and admitted by Application so a user-selected local parent can complete; the legacy pinned-root IStableLauncherHandoff path remains unchanged. No second Registry literal, parser, updater, verifier, repository, state writer, scanner or Setup executable is added. Missing development embedded resources fail closed as payload unavailable. This slice does not claim publish-resource evidence: the later protected packager slice must prove both exact embedded logical names before accepting a delivery artifact.
